capabilities: Record dictation in desktop Obsidian and stop or cancel a session
Send recordings to a self-hosted HTTPS transcription gateway
Insert the transcript at the captured cursor or selection
Configure expected languages, a vocabulary of up to 50 terms, and whole-line Markdown formatting commands
Recover pending transcripts in a dialog when the target note or selection has changed
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.14.5+, OS-encrypted SecretStorage and microphone access. Recordings capped at 4 minutes 55 seconds and 5 MiB. No hosted service or API key is supplied, and provider charges fall under the operator's OpenAI account. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in speech-to-text, and dictating without uploading note content to a hosted service requires a transcription setup of your own.

relations.evidence: If Cipherfold is present, dictation requires an unlocked compatible session and is cancelled before lock.
a self-hosted gateway and a paid OpenAI API account

summary: Dictation plugin that records audio in desktop Obsidian and inserts the transcript from a self-hosted HTTPS gateway at the cursor.
